name: copilot-pdf-utilities
description: PDF (and Word) Language Model tools for GitHub Copilot agent mode — read, create, merge, split, and edit PDFs and Word documents without MCP

chatParticipants.name: pdf
chatParticipants.description: Attach a PDF file and ask questions about it.

languageModelTools.name: pdf-utilities_read_pdf
languageModelTools.userDescription: Extract text content from a PDF file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Extracts text from a PDF file and returns the full text along with page count and basic metadata (title, author, page count, file size). Also returns wordCount and approxTokenCount for the extracted text. Use this when you need to read the content of a PDF. Supports an optional page range like '1-5' or '1,3,5-10'. Supports optional pagination via maxWords or maxTokens to limit the returned text. File path must be absolute.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the PDF file to read.

pageRange.description: Optional page range to extract, e.g. '1-5' or '1,3,5-10'. If omitted, all pages are extracted.

maxWords.description: Optional maximum number of words to return. Text is truncated at a word boundary if exceeded. The full wordCount and approxTokenCount are still reported.

maxTokens.description: Optional approximate maximum number of LLM tokens to return (uses ~4 chars/token heuristic). Text is truncated if exceeded. Ignored if maxWords is also set. The full wordCount and approxTokenCount are still reported.

languageModelTools.name: pdf-utilities_read_docx
languageModelTools.userDescription: Extract text content from a Word document (.doc or .docx).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Extracts text from a Word document (.doc or .docx) and returns the full text along with metadata (title, author, subject, last modified by, dates, file size, format). Also returns wordCount and approxTokenCount for the extracted text. Use this when you need to read the content of a Word document. Supports optional pagination via maxWords or maxTokens to limit the returned text. File path must be absolute.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the .doc or .docx file to read.

maxWords.description: Optional maximum number of words to return. Text is truncated at a word boundary if exceeded. The full wordCount and approxTokenCount are still reported.

maxTokens.description: Optional approximate maximum number of LLM tokens to return (uses ~4 chars/token heuristic). Text is truncated if exceeded. Ignored if maxWords is also set. The full wordCount and approxTokenCount are still reported.

languageModelTools.name: pdf-utilities_get_pdf_info
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get metadata and information about a PDF file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns metadata for a PDF file: page count, title, author, subject, creator, producer, creation date, modification date, file size, wordCount, and approxTokenCount. Use this to inspect a PDF without reading its full text content — useful for checking size before reading. File path must be absolute.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the PDF file.

languageModelTools.name: pdf-utilities_create_pdf
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a new PDF from text content.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new PDF file from plain text content. Supports optional metadata (title, author, subject), font size, and page size (e.g. 'A4', 'Letter'). The outputPath must be an absolute path ending in .pdf.

content.description: Text content to write into the PDF.

outputPath.description: Absolute path where the new PDF should be saved.

languageModelTools.name: pdf-utilities_merge_pdfs
languageModelTools.userDescription: Combine multiple PDF files into one.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Merges two or more PDF files into a single PDF. Pages are appended in the order the file paths are provided. All file paths must be absolute.

filePaths.description: Ordered list of absolute paths to PDF files to merge.

outputPath.description: Absolute path where the merged PDF should be saved.

languageModelTools.name: pdf-utilities_split_pdf
languageModelTools.userDescription: Extract a range of pages from a PDF into a new file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Extracts a subset of pages from a PDF and saves them as a new PDF. The pageRange accepts formats like '1-5', '3', or '1,4,7-10'. All file paths must be absolute.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the source PDF file.

outputPath.description: Absolute path where the extracted pages PDF should be saved.

languageModelTools.name: pdf-utilities_update_metadata
languageModelTools.userDescription: Update the title, author, subject, or keywords of a PDF.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Updates the metadata fields (title, author, subject, keywords) of an existing PDF. Can save the result to the same file or a new output path. File path must be absolute.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the PDF file to update.

outputPath.description: Absolute path to save the modified PDF. Defaults to overwriting the original.

languageModelTools.name: pdf-utilities_extract_pages
languageModelTools.userDescription: Save individual PDF pages as separate files.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Extracts specific pages from a PDF and saves each as an individual file in the output directory. Page numbers are 1-based. The output directory will be created if it does not exist. All paths must be absolute.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the source PDF file.

outputDir.description: Absolute path to the directory where extracted page files will be saved.

prefix.description: Filename prefix for extracted pages (default: 'page'). Files are named <prefix>_<pageNum>.pdf.

pdfUtilities.logLevel.description: Log level for PDF Utilities output.

pdfUtilities.maxPdfSize.description: Maximum PDF file size in MB for processing.
